content: simd-minimizers Rust crate (rust-seq, MIT, crates.io v1.4.0+): SIMD random minimizers, AVX2(x64)/NEON, builds on packed_seq+seq-hash. API minimizer_positions/canonical_minimizer_positions + builder minimizers(k,w)/canonical_minimizers(k,w)/closed_syncmers with .super_kmers().run().values_u64/u128. Paper SimdMinimizers SEA 2025 (Groot Koerkamp, Martayan). ~4s human genome single-thread. MUST verify MSRV<=1.80 and aarch64/PyO3 build compatibility (not yet confirmed against project MSRV 1.80).
